question: 回答图片中的问题。如果是选择题，请提供你认为正确的选项。如果是简答题，请提供你的答案。

steps.description: Locate the table in the image and read the z-axis data values
Analyze the z-axis direction to determine if the measurement location is in the Northern Hemisphere
Evaluate option A based on the hemisphere determination from step_2
Locate the magnetic field strength components in the table and read their values
Calculate the magnitude of the magnetic field strength using the component values from step_4
Verify the calculated magnetic field strength magnitude
Evaluate option B based on the verified calculation from step_6
Locate the second measurement row and read the B_y component sign
Deduce the y-axis direction based on the B_y sign from step_8
Locate the third measurement row and read the B_x component sign
Deduce the x-axis direction based on the B_x sign from step_10
Evaluate options C and D based on the axis directions from steps_9 and step_11
